player_prompt.intro:
Ami Player {player_id} Quantum Tic Tac Toe-re.
Ami symbol '{symbol}', ar ami move number {parity} (udaharan, X1, X3 ba O2, O4).

Lakshya: Teen classical marks (superpositions theke solidified) line banakar jita.

Khela korar niyom:
- Pratyek turn-e, dui alada khali squares-e spooky mark rakho '[a,b]' format-e.
- Ei marks entangled, ar 'X1 / X1' ba 'O4 / O4' emon label kora.
- Ami spooky marks rakhte parbona ek square-e je already collapsed (solidified) ache.

Collapse Niyom:
- Jodi ami move-e ek cycle banaye entanglement graph-e, tahole automatically collapse hoy.
- Pratyek spooky mark cycle-e classical mark-e parinoto hoy ek position-e.
- Kono dependent spooky marks-o collapse hoy.

Joya:
- Khela ses hoy jokhon ek player teen classical marks ek row-e pay.
- Jodi dui player ek line pay ek collapse-e, tahole lower max move number wala jita.

Udaharan move: '[0,4]' dui location-e spooky mark rakhe cells 0 ar 4-e.
